mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals the Federal Reserve's commitment to monetary easing, lowering discount rates and increasing equity present value, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the 3-month US Treasury yield above 3.5% signals tightening monetary policy, raising discount rates and compressing equity present value, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
